title: Venezuela: Economic Crisis Changes the Way a Country Pays
summary:
The following is an overview of the fintech ecosystem and its relation to wider economic development of Venezuela in 2026.   
The post Venezuela: Economic Crisis Changes the Way a Country Pays appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Venezuela's ongoing economic crisis is significantly transforming how people and businesses handle payments. As traditional financial systems struggle, the country's developing fintech ecosystem is playing an increasingly vital role in shaping wider economic development. This shift highlights how innovative financial technology adapts to severe macroeconomic challenges, altering everyday transactions across the nation.
content_ta: வெனிசுலாவின் தொடர்ச்சியான பொருளாதார நெருக்கடி, மக்கள் மற்றும் வணிகங்கள் பணப் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை கையாளும் முறையை மாற்றி அமைத்து வருகிறது. பாரம்பரிய நிதி அமைப்புகள் திணறிவரும் நிலையில், நாட்டின் வளர்ந்து வரும் fintech சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பு பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சியில் முக்கிய பங்கு வகிக்கிறது.

NatWest Appoints Former IKEA Executive to Lead Customer Experience and Digital Engagement
summary:
NatWest Group today announces the appointment of Harsh Agarwal as Managing Director, Customer Experience & Engagement. He joins the Retail Banking leadership team as the bank continues to pursue its growth ambitions.
Within Retail Banking, Customer Experience & Engagement brings together propositions, segment strategy and digital experience capabilities. Harsh will lead the function in creating simpler, more intuitive experiences across our mobile app, digital journeys, products and services, helping customers manage their money with greater ease and confidence.
Harsh brings senior leadership experience from global consumer businesses, including IKEA and Target, and a strong track record of connecting customer insight, digital innovation and commercial strategy.
Solange Chamberlain, CEO Retail Banking, NatWest Group, said:
"I'm really pleased to welcome Harsh to NatWest Group. Serving one in three UK families gives us an important role in helping customers build stronger financial futures. Harsh's global consumer experience and ability to turn insight into commercial value will help us deliver simpler, more personalised banking and grow deeper customer relationships."
Harsh Agarwal said: "This is an exciting time to join NatWest Group. The opportunity to make a meaningful difference for millions of customers through the strength of the NatWest brand is what drew me to the role. I look forward to meeting colleagues, listening and learning, and working together to help customers make progress."
NoYesPeople Moves11 Sep, 2026
content: NatWest Group has appointed former IKEA and Target executive Harsh Agarwal as Managing Director of Customer Experience and Engagement within its Retail Banking leadership team. In this role, Agarwal will lead efforts to enhance the bank's mobile app, digital journeys, and overall customer experience, aiming to provide simpler and more intuitive financial services for millions of customers across the UK.

Ethereum Breakout Looms As 116,000 Tokens Leave Exchanges, Tightening Supply
summary: Ether traded largely flat on Friday, with the second-largest crypto by market cap showing limited movement despite gaining nearly 3% over the past week.
content: Ethereum is showing potential for a market breakout as 116,000 tokens were recently withdrawn from crypto exchanges, significantly tightening the circulating supply. Despite this supply squeeze, Ether traded mostly flat on Friday. The second-largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization has nevertheless posted gains of nearly 3 percent over the past week, maintaining mild upward momentum.
content_ta: Ethereum exchanges-லிருந்து 116,000 tokens வெளியேறியுள்ளதால், சந்தையில் புதிய breakout ஏற்பட வாய்ப்புள்ளதாக கூறப்படுகிறது. இதன் மூலம் புழக்கத்தில் உள்ள supply குறைந்துள்ளது. வெள்ளிக்கிழமை அன்று Ether விலை பெரிய அளவில் மாற்றமின்றி இருந்தது. சந்தை மதிப்பில் இரண்டாவது பெரிய cryptocurrency-ஆன இது, கடந்த வாரத்தில் கிட்டத்தட்ட 3 சதவீதம் லாபம் ஈட்டியுள்ளது.

summary: Paysera clients can now create a personal access token themselves – free of charge and without a separate agreement – and hand it over to an AI assistant, accounting software, or a system built in-house.
